notes.title: June 2024 update now available
notes.notes:
The June 2024 update of Pedra Crystal Caves has now been released.

This update includes:


 Once you gain a Pedra upgrade, you keep the upgrade - forever
 The Crystals you collect throughout the game remain with you after you finish a game
 Same starting point for each cave after losing a life
 Additional music options
 Upgraded graphics


Grab your copy today!

notes.title: New version coming soon!
notes.notes:
After gaining lots of feedback from the community of players on various platforms, I've implemented them to create the next version of Pedra Crystal Caves.  

Besides a few bug fixes here and there, additional features include:

Once you gain a Pedra upgrade, you keep the upgrade - forever
The Crystals you collect throughout the game remain with you after you finish a game
Same starting point for each cave after losing a life
Additional music options
Upgraded graphics

This is in a final testing phase and will be released very shortly.
